events.title: Wicker
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 23 | An ostracized fisherwoman commissions the local basketmaker to weave her a husband, but when her wicker creation proves unexpectedly extraordinary, his presence ignites jealousy and upheaval that threatens their quiet village.

events.title: La Bola Negra
events.description: OPENS NOVEMBER 6 | Across three distinct eras, the intertwined lives of three men remain bound by a shared thread of desire, sexuality, enduring pain and the lasting weight of their complex legacies.

events.title: Wild Horse Nine
events.description: OPENS NOVEMBER 6 | Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris (John Malkovich) and Lee (Sam Rockwell) are dispatched from Santiago to Easter island by their bureau chief, MJ (Steve Buscemi). Spy shenanigans ensue. Written and directed by Martin McDonagh (In Bruges, The Banshees of Inisherin).

events.title: The Only Living Pickpocket in New York
events.description: OPENS OCTOBER 30 | When a theft goes awry, a veteran pickpocket is sent on a mission through New York to reclaim it.
